briefings.title: Vikings, Ragnar, Berserkers, Valhalla & the Warriors of the Viking Age | Lex Fridman Podcast #495
briefings.tldr: The Viking Age (793–1066 AD) was defined by unparalleled maritime mobility and a pragmatic warrior culture that reshaped Western civilization through "creative destruction," transitioning from terrifying raiders into the foundational architects of modern European states and the Byzantine Empire’s elite guard.
